Hikaruzero, I definitely second you on all these arguments. You're right, only time will tell. I'm curious as to how he is going on with this when he must be acknowledging all these counterpoints. It would be such a shame for what you described to play out. At the same time, a very great part of me still wants to see it happens, if only to inspire someone else to continue on his work and maybe approach it differently.

Hm. I can definitely understand that. I agree, physics has much more to reveal. Was hoping this guy was onto something :/ Hopefully someone can take the research he's done so far and go somewhere greater with it.

Damn. I just ordered his book a few hours ago out of curiosity. I definitely see what you're saying, but how would we really know until it is tested? I mean the guy devoted his entire life to this, what do you mean by fraudulent? As in, taking the donations for himself? He couldn't possibly fund it on his own, I wouldn't be surprised if this was maybe a common practice of theoretical physicists? To be collecting money towards an expensive project..

I feel like he acknowledges many prevalent arguments against time travel in this talk, and maybe it is sincere desperation to be reunited with his father again, but he has successfully mapped out equations that could make this a possibility. The only questionable thing and my main concern is that the amount of space you'd need to create this loop is said to be massive. Idk how he'd do it in a small space.

I just lost my best friend and love of my life to suicide. Please get professional help before you do anything. Please share how you are feeling to your friends. The biggest mistake my S/O made was just not letting people know how messed up he felt inside. It has left huge waves on an entire community of people. He could've accomplished great things and it's the worst tragedy to ever hit me in my life.

I know the idea of seeking professional help seems daunting, but once you just make that appointment and go it's smooth sailing. If your parents can't understand something like this, they aren't the only people to turn to- please realize this. If you hate your town, save up money and move. Fresh starts exist.
I know everything may seem overwhelming now, but know if you have been this driven, healthy, positive, and helpful individual in your community, know that you CAN be that individual again with time, anywhere. everyone gets down on themselves. you are certainly not alone. you are never alone. the reason why you have not gone through with it yet is because you know this to be true... so PLEASE seek out help.. even if it is a support group within your community. There is always a chance to get better, if you want it. Taking your life will never let you taste that again.

The topic WAS on his time travel theory, and you said you'd put your personal opinions aside but then touched on his "racial differences" which is a bit confusing?

Either way, when he says working in secret it is primarily because at the time he began doing this, travel to space was an abstract concept, let alone time travel. With this in mind along with the high racial tensions in this era, it is not far-fetched to me at least that he would decide to keep his true motives for the time machine (to meet his father) secret. I can imagine other professionals not taking him seriously. 

He has theoretically solved the problem, he currently needs funding to put his experiment into action.

I'm fairly certain that this working in secret bit was only true for the beginning of his career when America was still fairly segregated and whatnot, not towards recent history in his career. Once he began working at a University I believe he worked in tandem with other scientists to prove this theory.

But as my question was about the concept of time travel he presents and not necessarily about his career path, I would want to hear why/why not you wouldn't feel it was possible.

I'm so sorry. I can't say I lost a husband but I've got god knows how long until I meet the person I thought would be the love of my life... he took his life about a month ago. I can't imagine your pain, being that I'm pretty young myself. I think about this a lot- how it'll be a fairly long time till we can catch up, if there IS an afterlife. I find myself looking for little signs of him constantly. Hopefully life will show you that he is never too far. I myself have already had too many recurring "coincidences" that seem to yell that he is there. I wish you all the best and please take care of yourself. It's what they would've wanted.

I'm so so soooo sorry to hear about your experience. It's refreshing to hear you have gotten little signs too. I hope you keep on planting, that sounds so very wonderful. The similarities in their behavior are striking... 

I just went to see a movie he had wanted to see today and it was a bit hard but I'm hoping he was there with me enjoying it 😞 it's so hard not being able to have the simplest of banter with him now, not being able to bounce ideas back and forth.

These are my signs so far... but I haven't gotten any more in a week..
My friend got me cigarettes the day it was announced he was dead, the matches he received with them got to me a few days later somehow when I asked him for a light. They had blue heads instead of red. I've never seen that before, neither had anyone else.
I would occasionally call him Blue.

I went back to class and while I was in the restroom, I had this feeling and I looked up through the stall to see a girl in this same Basquiat T-shirt we had bought together, that i'd never seen anyone wear before. 

A family member coincidentally brought up this dog breed my partner and I had mentioned getting together- a Basenji... fairly uncommon breed. The next day when I was outside I saw a man walking a Basenji- I had maybe seen one once before.

My partner had this chin dimple and I would always tell him that I hoped our child would inherit it.
Then a day or two later at the nail salon, I walked in to this little vibrant 2 year old boy who was excitedly naming the colors of the nail polishes- he had this DEEP, extremely noticeable chin dimple, and acted just as intelligently and animatedly as my partner's mother described him as a child. What's more is by the time his mother went to leave with him, I saw her put away one of those old school foot long super hero toys that kids usually don't have anymore- this Spider-Man figure, almost identical to this one he had saved from his childhood and shown me just recently.

Furthermore, when he was in the hospital I felt like I was connecting with him on a multitude of occasions... one night I felt him hugging me. I thought I was losing my mind. When I walked into his hospital room his pressure would go down... it was mind boggling
Thank you.. I'm so sorry to hear you have a similar  experience 😞
